metadata.title: Fundamental groups of Calabi-Yau spaces
metadata.abstract: We study the fundamental groups of a normal projective Calabi-Yau variety $X$ with klt singularities and of its regular locus $X_{reg}$. We prove that both groups are almost abelian, and that their ranks are determined by the irregularities of finite etale and quasi-etale covers, respectively. Our approach is differential geometric, and relies on recent advances in the geometric theory of complex Monge-Ampere equations.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Calabi–Yau 奇异空间的基本群
analysis.workSummary: Theorem 1.1 把 singular Ricci-flat universal cover 上的 metric line 升级为 holomorphic/isometric C×Y splitting；Theorems 1.2–1.3 分别给 finite étale 和 quasi-étale A×Y cover，π₁(X) 与 π₁(Xreg) 的有限指数 free-abelian subgroup 秩分别为 2q′ 与 2q̃。
analysis.breakthrough: 主要新拓扑结论为 quasi-étale complementary factor 的 regular locus simply connected，从而确定 π₁(Xreg) 的结构。
analysis.limitations: X 为 connected normal projective klt 且 KX≡0；q′ 与 augmented irregularity q̃ 可不同。π₁(X) 的 almost-abelian 性已有相关结果，不能把全部结论描述为首次。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者说明 AI 仅用于 exposition 与 verification；结果先由作者获得，后结合新的几何分析工作推广。
